red_flags.detail: The committed top-level results.json in this directory is again the same B854-frame side-effect stray file (K_C_rank, verdict 'ABELIAN -- u(1)^4', etc.), byte-identical to the B901 and B904 copies -- but here the arc's OWN documentation (DRAFT_COMPLETENESS.md, 'Files' section) explicitly discloses and explains the bug: 'the BANKED results.json in this arc contains the B854 frame's verdict, not the selector sweep -- the frame's __file__-inherited write clobbered it pre-commit during the selector era ... Nothing load-bearing is lost (the sweep lives in sweep_results.json / results_complete.json, and the lock test reads sweep_results.json).' This arc is the ONLY one of the three (B901, B904, B907) in this batch to self-disclose the mechanism; the other two leave it unexplained in-arc.

DRAFT_COMPLETENESS.md is explicitly marked 'Status: computation agent (deliverable for the banking seat; NOT banked by this draft)' yet FINDINGS.md's own ADDENDUM section presents its C1/C2/C3 results as settled ('THE SIGN-LOCKING THEOREM -- the completeness follow-up is PAID') without flagging that the underlying DRAFT_COMPLETENESS.md document itself is titled DRAFT and states its own 'honest gap' at the form level is not closed. The ADDENDUM's headline ('is PAID') is stronger than the draft document's own stated residual gap; both are consistent on inspection (the draft's gap is explicitly about existence of OTHER forms beyond e6(2), not about the e6(2) result itself), but the FINDINGS-level headline compresses away the caveat in a way that could read as fully closed to a reader who does not open DRAFT_COMPLETENESS.md.
